top_stories.title: High-Level Committee Report on 'One Nation, One Election'
top_stories.summary: The Kovind Committee submitted its report recommending simultaneous elections to the Lok Sabha and State Legislative Assemblies in the first phase, followed by local body elections within 100 days.
key_takeaways: Requires constitutional amendments to Articles 83, 172, and 356.
Aims to reduce election expenditure, policy paralysis, and administrative strain.
Concerns raised regarding federalism and regional party visibility.

top_stories.title: Implementation of the Carbon Credit Trading Scheme (CCTS) Framework
top_stories.summary: The Ministry of Power and Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) finalized the operational guidelines for India's domestic carbon market to help meet its NDC targets under the Paris Agreement.
key_takeaways: Establishes a compliance market for obligated entities and a voluntary market for non-obligated entities.
Managed by the National Steering Committee for Indian Carbon Market (NSCICM).
Supports India's target of achieving Net Zero emissions by 2070.

top_stories.title: Progress under India Semiconductor Mission (ISM)
top_stories.summary: Approval of new commercial semiconductor fabrication units and packaging facilities in Gujarat and Assam under the $10 billion ISM umbrella.
key_takeaways: Aims to build a sustainable semiconductor and display ecosystem in India.
Reduces import dependency on critical microelectronics.
Fosters domestic supply chain resilience in strategic sectors.

top_stories.title: India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEC) Strategic Developments
top_stories.gs_paper: GS Paper II (International Relations & Bilateral Agreements)
top_stories.summary: Inter-governmental framework agreements are being finalized to push forward rail, ship-to-rail transit networks, and energy pipeline connections between India, the UAE, Saudi Arabia, and Europe.
key_takeaways: Unveiled during the G20 Summit in New Delhi as part of PGII (Partnership for Global Infrastructure and Investment).
Comprises the East Corridor (India to Arabian Gulf) and Northern Corridor (Gulf to Europe).
Serves as an alternative to China's Belt and Road Initiative (BRI).

top_stories.title: Deep Ocean Mission & MATSYA 6000 Trials
top_stories.gs_paper: GS Paper III (Economic Development & Security / Environment)
top_stories.summary: The Ministry of Earth Sciences progresses with deep-sea wet tests for the crewed submersible MATSYA 6000, designed to explore polymetallic nodules and deep-sea biodiversity.
key_takeaways: Part of India's Deep Ocean Mission launched in 2021.
Focuses on sustainable utilization of ocean resources for the Blue Economy.
Targets exploration of critical minerals like nickel, copper, cobalt, and manganese in the Central Indian Ocean Basin (CIOB).
